segments.text: Today's meeting is about the incident on Tuesday, when the application was unavailable for two hours.
The cause was an expired SSL certificate on the production server.
Ana, who is responsible for automatically renewing the certificates?
I take care of it. I set up automatic renewal by Thursday.
I add an alert in monitoring thirty days before expiration.
George, until when can you make the alert?
Until the end of next week.
We need to inform the affected customers, there were one hundred forty accounts.
Someone from support should send the email, not us.
Okay, I will ask the support team to send the email today.
I propose we also do a monthly recovery exercise.
No, for now we don't do monthly exercises, we'll return to the topic in January. I will write the incident report by Monday.
